@@U02410@@
The scoundrel!
How much he promises,
how little he delivers!

@@U02412@@
It’s clear, Herald,
you're good at announcing masks,
but it’s not a herald’s courtly duty
to delve beneath the surface.
That requires a sharper vision.
But I have no quarrel with you.
It is to you, my lord,
I will address my questions.

@@U02413@@
(He turns to 普路托斯.)

@@U02414@@
Wasn't it to me you entrusted
the whirlwind speed of your chariot?
And have I not successfully guided it for you?
Driven it well?
To where you've directed?
Have I not in bold flight soared aloft
to win for you the palm of victory?
Have I ever fought for you and failed?
And if a laurel wreath adorns your brow,
wasn't it | who wove it with wit and dedication?

@@U02416@@
If it is for me to bear witness
to your good character,
then I happily acknowledge
that you are spirit of my spirit.
Your every deed mirrors my will,
and you are far richer than I.
I prize above all my crowns
the laurel I now reward you with,
and I declare freely to all:
You are my belovéd son;
in you I am well pleased.
translation:
@@U02410@@
恶棍！
他承诺了多少，
他所提供的东西是多么少啊！

@@U02412@@
很明显，先驱报，
你很擅长宣传口罩，
但这不是传令官的宫廷职责
深入表面之下。
这需要更敏锐的眼光。
但我与你并无争吵。
这是给您的，陛下，
我将回答我的问题。

@@U02413@@
（他转向普路托斯。）

@@U02414@@
不是你托付给我的吗
你的战车旋风般的速度？
我还没有成功地给你引导过吗？
开得好吗？
去往你所指的地方？
难道我没有勇敢地翱翔在高空
为你赢得胜利的手掌？
我是否曾为你而奋斗却失败过？
如果月桂花环装饰你的额头，
不是吗|谁用智慧和奉献精神编织了它？

@@U02416@@
如果由我来见证
以你良好的品格，
然后我很高兴地承认
你是我灵魂的灵魂。
你的一举一动都反映了我的意志
而且你比我富有得多。
我珍视我所有的王冠
我现在奖励给你的桂冠，
我向所有人自由宣告：
你是我亲爱的儿子；
我对你很满意。
